text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm truly sorry!
All I do is cause trouble... ugh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'll go train right aw... Eek!
choice_data_list: If it hurts, let's call it off.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But... if I just stand still like this,
I feel like I'll lose even more confidence...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going...!
An injury like this... is n-no big deal at aaall!!
choice_data_list: I need you to rest for now.
Wanna head back and get some training in?
Wanna head back and get some training in?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going...!
An injury like this... is n-no big deal at aaall!!
choice_data_list: I need you to rest for now.
Wanna head back and get some training in?
Wanna head back and get some training in?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I just couldn't sit still and do nothing—
I'll stop if the pain gets worse. So please...!”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: T-That's... Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Understood... I'll take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...*sob*, ugh. I'm, I'm so zorry...
Getting injured has made me even more useless, uwaaah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swallowing her frustration, Meisho Doto
rested quietly until her injuries healed...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Thank you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Promise me you won't push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I will!
I'll stop if the pain gets worse, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Carefully... if I adjust my strength just like this...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ow... Owwwwww... !?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I barely used any force at all...
Wheee, I can't move like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Straining herself seems to have put extra stress on her body,
causing her injury to worsen...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Looks like I can manage it.
At this rate, I might even be able to push a bit harder...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes! You're right.
We promised not to push ourselves too hard...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By learning to control her output,
Meisho Doto was able to return to practice!
